llm_fields.description: An initiative by the Karnataka Minority Development Corporation to promote self‑employment and economic activities among minority communities by providing financial assistance to eligible individuals to start or expand their economic activities.
llm_fields.eligibility: The applicant must belong to a religious minority community as defined in the Government Order, be a permanent resident of Karnataka, be between 18 and 55 years of age, have a family annual income less than ₹1,03,000 in urban areas or less than ₹81,000 in rural areas, have no family member employed by State/Central/Government PSU, and not have availed benefits under any other KMDCL scheme (excluding the Arivu Scheme) in the last 5 years.
